look: Pyre Titan, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Cinder Motes family: giant of molten crystal and flame cracking the ground where it stands. Family anatomy: living sparks and fire elementals of black flame around a red orb. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are ember-red cinder crystal. Element Fire: ember red, orange and gold accents, vivid sweeping embers, flame ribbons and heat shimmer
